attributes.description: Pine Lake Youth exists to find and follow Jesus together! Our vision is that all students are welcomed into community, find engagement in worship, and experience apprenticeship to Jesus.  At Pine Lake Youth every student is invited to Be Yourself, Belong to Something Bigger, and Become Part of Bringing heaven to earth.  This includes opportunities for gathering on Tuesday nights as a youth group, on Sunday mornings serving and assisting in the service, participating on leadership teams, life groups, events, and other community activities.  We seek to welcome well, have fun well, worship well, and care well!

attributes.description:
TWO WAYS TO PARTICIPATE!
  1. MomCo Monday Meetups (full membership)
  2. MomCo Social Meetups only
Here at MomCo at Pine Lake, we gather and support moms. The MomCo (short for Mom Community) is a group of women, with children of all ages, going through life together. We believe in the simple but revolutionary idea that remarkable things happen when moms come together. If you are a mom with a child at home, of any age, we have a place for you!

See upcoming dates
